scripts.switcher:install: npm run switcher:build && sh -c 'target=$(command -v clovapi); test -n "$target" || exit 1; rm -f "$target"; cp switcher/clovapi "$target" && chmod +x "$target" && echo Installed to "$target"' && mkdir -p electron/bin && cp switcher/clovapi electron/bin/clovapi && chmod +x electron/bin/clovapi && echo Installed to electron/bin/clovapi
